title: HatchWorks Recognized as 2021 Atlanta Pacesetter | HatchWorks AI
description: HatchWorks Technologies Inc., has been named a 2021 Pacesetter by Atlanta Business Chronicle. This exclusive annual list of Atlanta’s fastest-growing companies represents the most comprehensive look at private business growth within the Atlanta metro area. Qualifying companies are ranked by a weighted growth index formula, factoring both employee growth and revenue growth, to create a level playing field amongst businesses of various sizes.
